rendered: According to the text, the Mn-substituted LNO cathodes deliver about 212 mAh g^− 1 (10% Mn)[1] and 164 mAh g^− 1[2] (50% Mn[3]), respectively. The authors attribute the lower capacity at higher Mn content to the electrochemical inactivity of the Mn ions, even though higher Mn content improves cycling stability. These values come from the discussion of the figure showing the galvanostatic charge/discharge profiles and cycling performance of these cathodes.Fig. 4[4]
